translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Timoteose Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Timoteo

content: We igar-napiragwaddo: Dule Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-e-dummadga gubiele, arbaed-nued-bina soged.

A-ular Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-e-dummadga gubiele, dule-nued-daed abeleged: Dule-egi-sunmaked-sated, dule-unnila-ome-wargwennaa-nikad, dule-na-dukin-sunna-san-bargaed, dule-binsaed-nikaa-daed, dule-mag-emar-dakee-daed, dule-nabir-emar-nue-ogabed, degi, yeer dulemar-odurdaked,
dule-geg-mungued, dule-geg-abin-abin-daed-amied, dule-geg-ibmar-iskanagi-mani-onoged, dule-gwenadgan-sabguerbad, dule-binnalee-na-san-bargaar-ibmar-saed, dule-maniginbi-dogdar-binsasulid.
Ar dule na e-neg-yagi neg wichur seele, ¿igi Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damaladdi adi nabir sebalosunna? Geg nabir sebardo.
Emiskwaa-dule-Bab-Jesúsba-nagusmalad, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-e-dummadga-gued abelesulid, ar abakalegi degiir nia-saila iskusadgii iskuarmogale, na san dummarba saedba.
Deginbali, dulemar-Bab-Jesúsba-nanaisurmalad-abargi na san-burba nued oyodibalid, adi mer amar egi ichakwa sunmakmalagar, ar degiir, abakalegi nia-sailase binsaed galedagele.
Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-bendakmalad amba deyobmo, dule-nued-nanaed, dule-unnila-iniki-ibmar-soged, dule-geg-mungued, dule-ibmar-iskanagi-geg-mani-onoged,
Ar we-dule nue wilubdaklegweler-gebed, na e-daedgi gwen akarsur daklegele, geb Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-bendakedga nugsalegodo.
Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-bendaked-omegande ambamodo, dule-nued-nanaed, wichur-gakangi-sunmaked, nue-binsaed-nikaa-daed, degi, bela ibmar-saedgi dulemar-geg-yardaked.
Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-bendakmalad unnila ome-wargwen-nikad abeleged, degine, na nue neg-wisi-seed-dule, degi, e-mimmigana na nue bargaar neg-yagi-sedibalid-dulebar.
Ar ade Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-bendakmalad nued arbaele, nue nug-nikaa gwenadgan-abargi gunonidaed, degine, nue Cristo-Jesúsgi-bensulidgi bur-nue dobsuli sunmakdamalad.
Emiskwasaar an bese nadapo an insado, be-daknamalagar. Degi-inigwele, an bese garda narmakdo,

adi an wis yoggud be an-dakele, be wisigar, igi be Bab-Dummad-neg-yaginmalad-abargi be nanaer-gebe. A-sogledo, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, amala Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid-e-sordamarye. Degisoggu, amala igar-napiragwad-ganimalad, igi buar neg-ganiki, ayobmodo, degi, amar a-igar-irwa gwisgumarbalidid.
Emide, Bab-Jesús-igar geg benguleged. We-igarde aku-itoleged-igalad, igala-dummadid, ar ade:

content.text: Degine, Bab Dummad Burba Nued dule-napiragwadye-nik sogsad.
Degi, Bab Dummad na e-nibnegse Jesús-onakwisad,
